name: OctiFi
long_description: We empower commerce with instant 0% interest loans for responsible spenders.  Consumers can now renovate their dream homes or buy furniture online with an extended budget and pay later at no extra cost.
one_liner: Buy Now Pay Later for Southeast Asia

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Ed Chin, based in Singapore, pioneered AI-driven credit underwriting for "buy now pay later" platform OctiFi (YC W21), driving its acquisition by Latitude Financial. A Yale graduate in Economics and Mathematics, Ed previously traded billions in distressed credit on Wall Street. Now, he's leveraging his expertise to revolutionize green asset financing across APAC with a new credit-focused platform backed by climate tech investors.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: I've strong experience in building and leading high performance engineering teams. Backend engineering comes easy to me, UI and UX are close to my heart and I keep a great deal of focus on how things are presented to the user.
